title.narrative: Enterprise Expansion Fund II under the Western Balkans Enterprise Development and Innovation Facility

description.narrative: This contract represents the EU contribution of EUR 19 million into the equity Enterprise Expansion Fund II. The fund will invest in companies with the aim to improve their governance, social and environmental impact. The action is linked to CN 430-066 which includes EUR 11 million technical assistance for the deployment of the fund and capacity building activities for start-ups.
